status: draft: values marked draft are working defaults taken from the authorship paper's example; the Director ratifies or replaces them

global.harmonic_dna: minor centre with major-colour inflections, sus/add tones, chromatic movement, tonal ambiguity
global.timbral_dna: analog polysynths, sequenced electronic bass, arpeggiators, gated ambience, restrained cinematic strings and brass

agent.role: The Agent: principal melodic signature of the protagonist

threat.role: The Threat: short gesture of danger, surveillance, exposure

mission.role: The Mission: recurring pulse / sequencing pattern

menu.function: isolated notes, pad and a restrained motif fragment

stealth.function: bass pulse, filtered sequencing, incomplete melodic gestures

alert.function: threat motif, intensified rhythm, harmonic destabilisation

major.function: expanded harmonic and melodic material for a major encounter

credits.function: the COMPLETE theme: dark intro, agent, movement, first statement, threat, ignition, main theme, variation, final statement, signature ending
